summary: C6 instructed agents to write non-D32 review-request stubs into .azoth/inbox/, which fails inbox schema validation when those stubs are present.
evidence: The C6 example JSON used request metadata rather than the 12 required D32 fields, and GitHub Actions run 24449656481 failed in tests/test_inbox.py because pr-review-codex-pr9-2026-04-15.jsonl was missing required fields.
recommended_action: Only write .azoth/inbox review files after a platform returns an actual finding, and serialize each finding as D32 JSONL.
